scientific_integrity: Exact analytical theorem and executable tests; time-inhomogeneous law credited to Kendall (1948); permutation/convex-order theorem is the assessed claim; no independent validation represented.
scientific_limitations: Single-type linear Markov branching with deterministic finite positive rate-duration phases, no immigration or density feedback; terminal metrics only; strongest historical original not full-text accessible; no external replication or independent audit.
title: Optimal phase ordering for survival and convex dispersion in a branching population
